note: main-stem lead (hrs from Pak Nam Pho) vs observed 2011 arrival day. After #3 (finer main-stem reaches C.3/C.35/C.29 with real-distance lags + modeling Tha Chin as a slow ~325km distributary) rho rose from 0.02 to ~0.76 — the model now orders provincial arrival well. Lags are set from river distance/celerity, NOT from the flood dates (no circularity). The residual mismatch is real: in 2011 the central plain (Ang Thong/Ayutthaya) filled about the same time as the Nakhon Sawan breach, which a downstream-ordered model cannot capture.
